items: Every voice recast the new way and picked by you: paramedic 1 a, paramedic 2 d, the driver d (angry), the minister d, the constable b on the radio.
Score: c2, percussion only, cut dead on the flatline.
The end: the push into the monitor cuts to the flatline end card made in Flow (two last beats, then flat), and the real logo comes up on it. 29.2 s, about 3 s longer than round 5.
Round 6b, your picks page round 8: the bleach bypass filter over every shot (the logo untouched), and doors a (LS21-a) inside the ambulance.
Whether 29 s is too long: the end card could lose a second.
Then Premiere: say so and I build r6 into it and push to Drive.
